g.text: Measure the complete Salesforce jobbefore expanding the experience
Observe the existing job, then put a scoped packet in the meeting record’s context.
Where reps start → what they copy → whom they consult → what they verify → how they follow through
Select one identifiable job, such as preparing for a meeting with a resolved advisor.
Use similar existing and assisted cases.Counterbalance preparation order where feasibleto reduce learning effects.
The baseline includes preparation, checking,rework and post-meeting action.
Time to an accepted brief; active preparation,review and rework; useful questions and relevantomissions; return use; completed follow-through.
Qualified opportunities and sales effects requireseparate outcome measurement and attribution.
Salesforce integration is underway. This is a proposed workflow study, not evidence of realized sales lift.
